about: Public Greenhouse job boards: list and search a company's open jobs, get job details with application questions and apply links, and browse company info, departments, offices and degree options.

commands.summary: List all open jobs on a company's Greenhouse board, with title, location, apply link (absolute_url) and publish dates

params.name: boardToken
params.description: Company board token, the slug in job-boards.greenhouse.io/{token}

params.name: content
params.description: true adds each job's description HTML, departments and offices. Output is much larger.

commands.summary: Search one company's job board by keyword, with optional department and office filters (50 jobs per page)

params.name: keyword
params.description: Free-text search over job titles and content

params.name: department
params.description: Department id to filter by (from list-departments)

params.name: office
params.description: Office/location id to filter by (from list-offices)

commands.summary: Get one job post: description, location, departments, offices, apply link (absolute_url) and application form questions
Get a company's job board info: company name and board description
List a company's departments (ids for the department filter), each with its open jobs
Get one department and its open jobs
List a company's offices/locations (ids for the office filter), with their departments and jobs
Get one office/location with its departments and open jobs
List degree options used in Greenhouse application education questions
